title: Reach each top-level page from the desktop navbar
preconditions: The local app is running and the doctor check passes.

steps.action: Open / and inspect the main navigation.
steps.expected: Home, Experiences, Questions, Analytics, and About are listed, and Home is marked as the current page.
Each destination renders its heading and the matching navbar item becomes current.
Experiences, Questions, and About links are present and point at the same routes.
